designs.name: 余烬·断脊
designs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: a single full-length original TWO-HANDED BATTLEAXE concept illustration for the Heteromorphic geometric energy weapon collection in a fantasy RPG mod. Tall portrait image. Black charcoal backdrop, weapon entirely visible with safe margins from axe tip to pommel, upright composition, near frontal three-quarter view showing solid thickness. Visually striking sculptural GEOMETRY, thick planar volumes, clean bold edges, saturated colored luminous faces with restrained emissive outlines. Long straight practical two-handed haft and unobstructed lower grip, head occupies upper third, believable connected construction. Flat clean energy material: no realistic metal, no crystals, no marbling or cloudy veins, no rust/scratches, no leather, no gems, no runes, no six-point stars. Sparse 5-8 small geometric particles near blade, subtle soft halo, not blinding bloom. Not a thin wireframe, not a pile of needles, no floating detached head parts. No person, hands, environment, text, logo, labels, montage or additional weapon. Crafted polished professional concept art, sharp readable silhouette. Palette crimson with coral-red edge emission. Radical asymmetrical single-bladed battleaxe: broad SOLID oblique parallelogram cleaver head, swept forward at 30 degrees, long straight diagonal outer cutting edge and deep angular lower beard, thick beveled blunt spine. Head has NO hole and NO triangular window. Upper head a compact angled flat cap, short squared stepped counterweight on other side of shaft, one wide angular neck integrated into blade root. Emphasize a heavy monolithic slab contrasted with long clean slender-but-sturdy haft, three large structural planes rather than decoration. A shallow inset parallel luminous slash on blade surface (not a hole). Simple heavy tapered hexagonal pommel. Tiny red square sparks.

A radical eccentric annular axe: head is ONE thick broad C-shaped cutting blade forming about 270 degrees of a faceted circle, with a conspicuous open gap in the upper-right quadrant. Annular blade is wide and weighty along outer right cutting arc, narrow on inner rear return; two short solid triangular braces join socket to rim leaving a real large central void. Distinctive ends of C blade: upper end a blunt diagonal cap, right end a sharp broad hooked point. Not a staff ornament, not a thin ring, not two bat wings: unmistakable sharpened axe cutting arc. 10-12 large facets approximate the circle. Angular open lozenge pommel. Tiny lavender crescent particles near blade, no giant orbiting halo.
